description: Confirms whether an address received a specific amount of genuine USDT within a time window on Tron, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base. Ignores fake tokens that copy the USDT name. Use before releasing goods, crediting an account or marking an invoice paid. Costs $0.005 per call in USDC on Base, Polygon or Arbitrum (x402).

amount.description: Expected USDT amount, for example 25 or 25.50

chain.description: Blockchain: tron, ethereum, bsc, polygon, arbitrum, base. Default tron

from.description: Optional sender address the payment must come from

minutes.description: How far back to look, 1 to 10080. Default 60

to.description: Address that should have received the payment (Tron T… or EVM 0x…, matching chain)

txid.description: Optional transaction id the payment must match

name: verify_usdt_payment
